newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL'S IGP-M INDEX RISES 0.08 PCT JUL 21-JUL 31.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL'S IGP-M INDEX RISES 0.08 PCT JUL 21-JUL 31.

text.p: Brazilian prices rose 0.08 percent between July 21 and July 31, compared with 0.00 percent in the June 21-June 30 period, as measured by the IGP-M index released by the Getulio Vargas Foudation (FGV).

The IGP-M is composed of three other economic indicators: the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 0.04 percent in the period; the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 0.03 percent in the period; and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.42 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting, the IPC a 30 percent weighting and the INCC 10 percent, the FGV said.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over 10-day intervals, is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
